context: Delete the dead preliminary notice branch. Then bound resolution WORK rather than the first unique-ID slice - resolve in bounded batches until MAX_COMPARE_SELECTIONS canonical IDs are found, and describe any IDs never processed as unprocessed rather than as proven overflow.
description: lib/compareRecovery.ts:70 and pages/Compare.tsx:140 call planCompareIds(rawIds, rawIds.length). Because the limit equals the input length, overflow is always empty and the notice branch at Compare.tsx:145-149 is unreachable dead code. The uncapped list is then fully resolved - one resolveShortId round trip per raw ID - before being sliced to MAX_COMPARE_SELECTIONS, so a crafted ?ids= with fifty entries fires fifty DuckDB round trips to discard forty-six. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT found in review: the obvious fix of bounding that first call to four is WRONG. Alias deduplication happens after resolution at compareRecovery.ts:84-96, so capping the raw slice would discard a later unique ID whenever earlier entries resolve to the same run, breaking the documented alias-before-limit contract and its tests at compareRecovery.test.ts:38 and Compare.test.tsx:300. The post-alias overflow path is live and correct; only the preliminary branch is dead. Verified at HEAD 39ead3a41.
